observations.value: Decision (accepted Oct 12, 2026): FR-S14 writes with PATCH and If-Match (412 when stale); the challenge key is removed with a PATCH setting it to null; PATCH is synchronous, so the server waits only for operations PUT returns; up to 10 retries with backoff from 50 ms capped at 1 s and jitter. Open: the rate of ETag changes on an idle instance. Evidence: runs 20261012T190928Z-g-l14-*.
